summary: The candidate change skips the menu session refresh after an unsuccessful login and adds focused coverage for aborted login; no blocking defect was found.

evidence: scripts/api_cli_terminal.ts line 455 now refreshes the session only when outcome.ok is true, so cancelled or failed login skips the session read.
tests/api-cli-terminal.test.ts lines 276-322 adds a focused Ctrl-C login test with a stalled second session read and asserts that only the initial session read occurs and the terminal closes.
